    Digital Art Foundation – Certificate of Achievement

      Program Summary

      The Certificate of Achievement in Digital Art Foundation provides essential knowledge and skills for digital artists. It can serve as a stand-alone certificate, or as the basis for continued study in digital illustration, animation, gaming or other areas. 

      Learning Outcomes:
      1. Employ the elements and principles of visual design in creative work.
      2. Employ drawing techniques in various areas of design practice.
      3. Analyze and apply color in creative work.
      4. Use industry-standard digital media software to create and edit files.
      5. Critique, verbally and in writing, visual media design work.

      Program Requirements and Completion Time
      The minimum time for completion of this certificate is 2 semesters. Completion time will vary based on student preparation and number of classes completed per semester.Program Requirements Last Revised: Fall 2026

      Department: Visual Media Design
